decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system has only a website mention and is peripheral to the announced sustainable/intelligent lighting direction, so weak sunk-cost and public-commitment pressures make dropping likely.
The dedicated product page signals visible public commitment and marketing investment, leading management to justify the sunk effort and persist with the desk lamp.
As a core general interior luminaire with a dedicated page, it is central to the firm's strategic direction and strongly publicly committed, so escalation pressures keep it on the market.
Although only mentioned on the website, the pendant luminaire is a core energy-efficient interior product, and the firm's commitment to its interior lighting portfolio outweighs the lower visibility.
The marine HMI searchlight is a niche, non-core product with only a website mention, so low public commitment and centrality reduce escalation pressures and favor dropping.

This marine searchlight has minimal website visibility and is not central to the announced sustainable lighting direction, and overlaps with other marine products, making management more willing to drop it.
